title: Mus'ab bin al-Zubayr and Ayishah His Wife
logline: A young noble sends a clever go-between to describe the woman he hopes to marry, marries her despite a teasing warning, and learns with all Medina that his bride is proudly, openly in love with him.
moral: Affection between husband and wife is nothing to be ashamed of; a frank answer can end an argument without quarrel.
tone: Light, warm, teasing comedy of manners. Everything intimate stays behind a curtain, a door or shutters and is shown only as hearts, a moving moon and the faces of the people outside.

beats.summary: Musab meets clever Izzah in Medina.
He sends her to look at Ayishah before he proposes.
Izzah returns with an absurdly long report.
The report turns frank; Musab blushes.
Big feet, and the joke that he will struggle to keep up.
He takes it seriously and still chooses her.
The wedding: Ayishah is seen at last; the curtain closes.
Izzah gathers the bride and the women of Quraysh.
Her love verses curl round Musab in front of everyone.
The wedding night from outside: hearts while the moon crosses the sky.
Next morning a woman praises his vigor.
A visitor overhears from the front room.
She confronts Ayishah: are you not ashamed?
No quarrel and no punishment: the tale ends on her frank answer.

sets.description: Medina street by day: marketStreet({palette:'clear', stalls:[{x:210, kind:'cloth'}]}) at w 1000. The palace facade on the right plays Talhah's house; use A.palace.door and A.palace.balcony anchors.
The same street and facade at night and at dawn: palette 'cold', palace 'lit', time of day keyed with u; balcony shutters close. Ground y 900.

The couple's house: palaceHall variant 'merchant', wall 'ochre', no coin desk; its curtain (0..1) on the right is the door of the private room; window pane shows the time of day; one or two stools and a small table.
Izzah's reception room: palaceHall variant 'palace', wall 'ochre', throne and dais off, carpet, lamps lit, five floor cushions and a tray; the door arch at the left frames Musab.

props.description: Planned scroll with wavy lines; here with len 0..1 up to 900 units so it reaches the ground and rolls on.
Planned wordless picture balloon; icons for this film: face, eyes, nose, smile, slippers, bolt, arm, blush, heart.
Planned poetry ribbon that unrolls along a curve, carries heart and kiss icons, and curls round Musab.
Planned loose floor cushion, five used in the majlis.
Planned round portrait of a person head; used for Musab in balloons and Ayishah with a crown.
Library heart(ctx, x, y, r): the film's discreet sign for everything that happens behind curtains and shutters.
Library black cat on the roof line in S10, the only witness of the wedding night.

scenes.composition: Visitor seated on a stool at x 420 (A.stools[0].sitY), a cup in her hand, small table beside her. Curtain alcove closed at the right (A.curtain). Hearts and arcs come from the curtain top at about (880, 560). Rank balloon above the visitor at (430, 330).

actions.action: the couple's front room by day; tag ANOTHER DAY
actions.acting: window shows noon

actions.action: sits waiting with a cup, looking round the room politely
actions.acting: idle: sips, blinks, foot taps
actions.library: person({costume:'lady', pal:VISITOR, age:0.5, sit:1, seat:'stool'}) + breathe

actions.action: three white sound arcs pulse out from the curtain toward her
actions.acting: her cup stops halfway to her mouth

actions.action: freezes; only her pupils slide toward the curtain
actions.acting: suspense by stillness: gaze [1, 0], no blink

actions.action: a heart pops over the curtain rod, then two more; the curtain hem ripples
actions.acting: curtain sways (swing), hearts bob

actions.action: cups her ear without meaning to, leans toward the curtain
actions.acting: tip 0.08, brows climbing

actions.action: bigger heart burst and a small OH! in red at the curtain top
actions.acting: visitor jolts: cup tips and one drop flies
actions.library: hearts + S.emphasis small; cup rot key

actions.action: both hands to her cheeks, eyes wide, mouth o
actions.acting: flush rises, turban of the veil quivers (tremble 1.5)

actions.action: looks to camera: can you believe this?
actions.acting: one deliberate lens stare, then back to the curtain

actions.action: a thought balloon pops over the visitor: Ayishah portrait wearing a small crown, on a pedestal
actions.acting: the visitor points at the balloon, then at the curtain, back and forth

actions.acting: visitor measures the height with a flat hand

actions.action: a last heart floats from the curtain straight into the thought balloon and lands on the crowned portrait; ?! pops
actions.acting: visitor slumps on the stool, fanning herself with her hand

actions.action: the curtain rod rings jingle; the curtain starts to open
actions.acting: visitor snaps upright, grabs her cup, pretends to sip

scenes.summary: Musab leaves, whistling. The visitor turns on Ayishah: are you not ashamed, with me in the house?

camera.notes: Widen to the whole room (zoom 1.1) as Musab crosses right to left and exits by the door; then two-shot on the women (zoom 1.5) from 152.7.

scenes.composition: Musab walks from the curtain (x 860) across the back of the room to the door at the left (A.door) passing behind the seated visitor. Ayishah comes to x 640 facing left; visitor rises at x 420 facing right. Eye lines level.

actions.action: steps out from the curtain straightening his turban, a spring in his step
actions.acting: content smile, eyes half shut; notices the visitor, small polite nod

actions.action: walks out through the door whistling (two music notes), the door closes behind him
actions.acting: never slides; visitor head turns to follow him out, staggered a beat late

actions.action: comes out from the curtain tidying her veil, perfectly calm, big slippers first
actions.acting: serene smile, chin level, blink

actions.action: stands up sharply, finger raised
actions.acting: brow V (0.8), mouth open, sit 1 to 0 with overshoot

actions.action: shakes the finger at her, other hand on hip; small speech balloon with a red blushing face icon and ?
actions.acting: talk mouth, flush still on her own cheeks

actions.action: points at herself with both hands
actions.acting: indignant, brows up in the middle

actions.action: sweeps a hand round the room: in the house!
actions.acting: gaze follows the hand, then pins Ayishah

actions.action: listens, head a little to one side, not a flicker of shame; a slow blink
actions.acting: the pause before the answer: only a blink and a growing smile

scenes.summary: Ayishah answers without apology: a wife should show her husband all the affection and desire she can, and she hides it neither by day nor by night.

camera.notes: Two-shot zoom 1.5 to 160.3, then a slow push on Ayishah (zoom 1.9, head at panel centre) through 166.6; back to the two-shot for the day and night icons at 171.3.

scenes.composition: Ayishah at x 640 facing left, the visitor at x 420. Answer balloon above Ayishah (centre 660, 320, 380 x 240). Sun icon pops at the left of her head (x 520, y 380), moon icon at the right (x 800, y 380); the window pane behind shows day then night for one beat each.

actions.action: lifts her chin and steps one pace forward
actions.acting: calm, warm, direct gaze into the visitor eyes; no blush

actions.action: opens both palms: nothing to apologise for; a small card SORRY is struck out with a red X
actions.acting: shrug with a smile; visitor blinks twice

actions.action: raises a teaching finger
actions.acting: brow slightly up, talk mouth

actions.action: hand to her own chest
actions.acting: sincere, lid 0.2

actions.action: answer balloon pops with Musab portrait medallion
actions.acting: her gaze flicks to the door he left by

actions.action: a heart joins the portrait in the balloon
actions.acting: visitor mouth closes, brows relax a notch

actions.action: the heart doubles and beats; Ayishah both arms open wide
actions.acting: big unapologetic smile; visitor leans back from the force of it (tip -0.06)

actions.action: holds up two fingers: and another thing
actions.acting: playful now

actions.action: mimes hiding behind her veil edge for a second, then throws it open: not me
actions.acting: peek then reveal with a laugh

actions.action: sun icon pops at her left; the window pane turns bright day
actions.acting: she points at it

actions.action: moon icon pops at her right; the window pane turns to night with stars
actions.acting: she points the other way; visitor head goes sun, moon, Ayishah

scenes.summary: The frank answer ends the tale: no quarrel, no punishment. The visitor gives up, laughs, and the two women sit down to tea; Musab peeks back in. THE END.

camera.notes: From the two-shot pull out slowly to the full room (zoom 1.05) by 178.5; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Visitor and Ayishah sit on two stools at x 420 and x 600 with the small table between. Two cancelled icons pop above them at y 330 (x 420 crossed swords, x 600 a gavel), each with a red X. Musab head and one hand appear round the door at the left at 179.0. THE END title in the upper third, clear of all faces.

actions.action: opens her mouth to argue, finds nothing, shuts it
actions.acting: mouth o then closed, eyes side to side

actions.action: throws up her hands, then laughs
actions.acting: shrug, eyes shut, shoulders bounce

actions.action: laughs with her and offers the cup back
actions.acting: warm, equal; they sit down together

actions.action: icon of two crossed swords pops and is crossed out
actions.acting: both glance up at it and nod

actions.action: icon of a judge gavel pops and is crossed out
actions.acting: visitor clinks her cup against Ayishah cup

actions.action: peeks round the door: head and a hand; Ayishah sees him and a heart pops between them across the room
actions.acting: he grins and waves; she smiles sideways; visitor rolls her eyes fondly

actions.action: THE END title pops and holds to 183.3; hearts drift slowly; everyone keeps breathing and blinking
actions.acting: held ending, small idle motion only

ending.description: After the last word (179.64) the two women sit over tea with the two cancelled icons (quarrel, punishment) above them, Musab waving from the door and one heart between husband and wife. THE END pops at 180.0 and holds to 183.3 with idle breathing, blinks and slowly drifting hearts.

subtitles.ar: في المدينة المنورة التقى مصعب بن الزبير امرأة ذكية اسمها عزة.|أخبرها أنه يفكر في الزواج من عائشة بنت طلحة،|وطلب منها أن تزورها، ثم تصف له شكلها وصفاتها قبل أن يتقدم إليها.
subtitles.en: In Medina, Musab bin al-Zubayr met a clever woman called Izzah.|Considering marriage to Ayishah daughter of Talhah,|he asked Izzah to visit and describe her.

subtitles.ar: ذهبت عزة وعادت بتقرير مفصل.|مدحت وجه عائشة وعينيها وأنفها وابتسامتها،|ثم وصفت قامتَها وأعضاء جسدها بتفصيل جريء.|لم تكن مهمتها السؤال عن ثروتها أو نسبها، بل عن جمالها.
subtitles.en: Izzah returned with a detailed report|praising Ayishah’s face, eyes, and figure,|including unusually frank physical descriptions.|Her assignment had been to assess beauty.

subtitles.ar: قالت عزة أيضًا إن قدمي عائشة كبيرتان،|وأضافت مزحة توحي بأن مصعبًا قد يجد صعوبة في مجاراة رغبتها بعد الزواج.|أخذ مصعب كلامها بجدية، لكنه لم يتراجع عن اختياره.
subtitles.en: Izzah noted Ayishah’s large feet|and joked that Musab might struggle to match her passion after marriage.|He did not abandon his plan.

subtitles.ar: تزوج مصعب عائشة بالفعل.|وتروي الحكاية أن حياتهما الزوجية بدأت بقرب شديد ورغبة متبادلة.|وبعد الزواج دعت عزة العروس ونساء من قريش إلى مجلس في بيتها للاحتفال والاجتماع.
subtitles.en: Musab married Ayishah.|The tale says their married life began with strong mutual desire.|Afterward Izzah invited the bride and women of Quraysh to a gathering.

subtitles.ar: وقفت عائشة في المجلس، وكان مصعب قريبًا منها،|وأنشدت أبياتًا في الحب والقبل.|أظهرت كلماتها أنها تفكر في زوجها حتى عندما تتحدث عن الجمال والمودة أمام النساء الحاضرات.
subtitles.en: At the gathering, with Musab nearby,|Ayishah recited verses about love and kisses,|suggesting her husband was on her mind even among the guests.

subtitles.ar: لم تخف الحكاية الجانب الحميم من علاقتهما؛|بل تذكر أن مصعبًا أمضى ليلة الزفاف معها في لقاءات متكررة.|وفي اليوم التالي أثنت امرأة تعرفه على نشاطه وقوته في تلك الليلة.
subtitles.en: The narrative is frank about their intimacy,|saying they spent their wedding night together repeatedly.|The following day a woman praised Musab’s vigor.

subtitles.ar: وفي مناسبة أخرى سمعت امرأة أصوات عائشة أثناء لقائها بزوجها.|استغربت أن تتصرف امرأة صاحبة مكانة معروفة بتلك الصراحة،|وسألتها بعد خروج مصعب: ألا تخجلين من هذا وأنا في البيت؟
subtitles.en: On another occasion a woman overheard Ayishah during an intimate encounter.|Surprised by such openness from a woman of rank,|she questioned her afterward.

subtitles.ar: أجابتها عائشة بلا اعتذار: ينبغي أن تعبر المرأة لزوجها عما تستطيع من مودة ورغبة.|وأضافت أنها لا تخفي ذلك نهارًا ولا ليلًا.|بهذا الجواب الصريح تنتهي الحكاية دون خصام أو عقوبة.
subtitles.en: Ayishah answered unapologetically that a wife should show her husband affection and desire.|She did so by day and night, she said.|The tale ends there.

new_assets.name: scroll (long)
new_assets.description: Planned scroll with wavy lines, len 0..1 up to 900 units, with a rolled end that falls, bounces and rolls along the ground.
new_assets.implementation: Paper rectangle from the hands down to the ground with wavy lines every 26 units, a roll circle r 18 at the free end; fallY + rebound for the drop, then x keyed along the ground with the strip laid flat.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English is a condensed translation in several paragraphs (P1 omits "before he proposes", P2 omits the nose, the smile, and wealth or lineage, P3 omits "Musab took her words seriously", P7 omits the quoted question "Are you not ashamed of this while I am in the house?"); both languages are kept verbatim as supplied.
All intimacy is staged off screen (curtain, closed shutters, hearts, the moon crossing the sky, the reactions of a cat and of the visitor); default: nothing more explicit than a heart is ever drawn.
The frank physical description in P2 is shown as a whisper and a balloon of squiggle lines with a FRANK! stamp, not as pictures; default: keep it wordless.
The joke in P3 is softened to a thought cloud of Musab puffing behind a briskly striding bride; default: keep this "keeping up" metaphor.

Ayishah is drawn with a visible face under a white veil and with large yellow slippers as a running gag from the "large feet" line; default: keep, since the script states it, but it can be dropped after S5.
These are named historical figures (Musab bin al-Zubayr, Ayishah bint Talhah); default: drawn as generic Library comic figures with name tags, in a respectful, affectionate tone.
Added background business not in the script: a roof cat watching the wedding night, Musab whistling as he leaves, Musab peeking round the door at THE END, the women sharing tea; default: keep.

Invented English lettering: KNOCK KNOCK!, FWIP!, FRANK!, BIG!, HA HA!, PHEW!, YES!, SWISH!, MWAH!, HEE HEE!, AGAIN!, STRONG!, OH!, ?!, SO THERE!; default: keep all, AGAIN! and OH! are the first to cut if the owner wants it tamer.
S10 and S11 show the wedding night as a flashback after the majlis, following the script order, with a tag THE WEDDING NIGHT; default: follow the script order rather than move it next to the wedding.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. Word cues: w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue in this plan is the start time of the named Arabic word in planning/inputs/timeline.md.

Sets are Library calls: marketStreet (medinaStreet, nightStreet) and palaceHall (coupleHome = variant 'merchant', majlis = variant 'palace'). Take all positions from the returned anchors (A.palace.door, A.palace.balcony, A.door, A.curtain, A.stools); the x values in this plan are approximate, measure on the set.

People: person({costume, pal, age}) with LIFE.t = t for automatic blinks; explicit lid values need a hand blink (Math.max(lid, blink(t, seed))). Every figure always has a gaze target (lookAt / look / gazePlan).
Walks use walk(fnX, t) + footfalls so feet never slide; sits are sit 0..1 with settleTo; hops use anticipate + hop + landSquash.

The curtain of palaceHall merchant (curtain 0..1) is the private room. Draw the couple before the curtain layer so they are hidden when it closes, then hearts after it. If the set draws the curtain inside its baked pass, use the behind/front split or redraw the curtain strip from the anchor after the cast.
S9: draw Musab through the door arch with the palaceHall behind(ctx) callback so the arch frames him; the verseRibbon loop needs a back pass before him and a front pass after him.
S10: no person is drawn. Only the facade, shutters, lamp flicker, hearts, moon (u keyed 0.62 to 0.95) and the Library cat. S11 continues the same u through dawn to 0.1.
Thought clouds: thoughtCloud with scale so the figures inside are at least 110 px on screen (cloud 520 x 340 at zoom 1.3 with figures at s 0.55).

Lettering diet: 15 comic words plus name tags; no lettering over a face; no en or em dashes. Tags (MEDINA, MUSAB, IZZAH, AYISHAH, THE WEDDING, IZZAH'S HOUSE, WOMEN OF QURAYSH, THE WEDDING NIGHT, ANOTHER DAY, LADY OF RANK) use S.label / S.box at 28 px or more.

Sound: 6 quiet effects only, in the listed pauses (7.8 pop, 22.7 whoosh, 91.8 chime, 150.0 pop, 157.08 pop) and after the last word (180.3 chime); SND master 0.6. The narration is dense, so do not add more.
One LATER card at 81.2 (after the wedding, before the gathering) with the camera cut hidden at its midpoint. Other scene changes are wipes, an iris into the night flashback and a dissolve to morning.
Panel shake only inside the picture panel; call the style finish last every frame.
warnings: Adult theme: the script speaks openly about a married couple's intimacy. The staging is deliberately discreet; do not add anything more explicit when implementing.
The narration has only four pauses of 0.6 s or more, so sound effects are few.
The palaceHall merchant curtain is narrow (about 110 wide); if two figures do not hide behind it, widen it with the curtain geometry option or let them exit past its edge.

Six women share two costume families; keep the palettes far apart (red Ayishah, green Izzah, purple visitor, orange neighbour, blue/yellow/purple-grey/brown guests) and use name tags on first appearance.
S9 is 21 s in one room: the camera plan (close, reveal, wide, close, wide) and the travelling ribbon must carry it.
